n: CMU legacy free robotics curricula (EV3, NXT, VEX IQ ROBOTC)
t: Older free Carnegie Mellon robotics courses for NXT, EV3, VEX IQ and ROBOTC.
steps: Open the course page or the CS2N listing for the course you want.
Check that your school still owns working NXT, EV3 or VEX kits.
Ask IT about the software. The EV3 intro lists Windows XP through 8 and Mac OS X 10.8 or later.
Download the course files and test one project.
Plan about 6 weeks for the EV3 intro course.
Check what CS2N stores before students sign in.
Keep a backup plan for kits that fail.
